title: Unsupervised pretraining in biological neural networks
goal: Surpass the source-paper result on the same task: Recover the source-native retinotopy encoding fit of neural responses to natural images: Fn(img)=an*(K convolved with img)(kn,xn,yn), with positive amplitude an and each neuron's assigned kernel and spatial position. Treat resulting cross-mouse mapping as the original downstream use, not an invented decoder task.
primary_outputs: Candidate method and outputs for the source task: Recover the source-native retinotopy encoding fit of neural responses to natural images: Fn(img)=an*(K convolved with img)(kn,xn,yn), with positive amplitude an and each neuron's assigned kernel and spatial position. Treat resulting cross-mouse mapping as the original downstream use, not an invented decoder task.

Source-paper comparison for Original fixed-capacity retinotopy neural-response reconstruction endpoint, if an evaluated source comparison can be recovered: Source describes correlation-based matching during fitting, but an evaluated reconstruction statistic, exact formula/normalization, numeric comparison and scored panel are not established. Do not assume a held-out R-squared, invent a loss, or treat lower internal optimizer cost as a paper-performance win.
success_criteria: First establish that the original paper evaluates an ordered retinotopy reconstruction/estimation endpoint, identify its exact panel/statistic and baseline, and verify that a meaningful fixed-capacity method comparison exists.
Recover the original reference mouse, image/repeat identities, full eligible cell populations, fitting conditions and exact score aggregation. Source description alone is not evaluator readiness.

Preserve the original 200 kernels of 13x13, source response parameterization, image processing and complete source evaluation cases; additional kernels, easier subsets or extra inputs cannot create a same-task win.
Reproduce the source-author method and original evaluated score before comparing a frozen candidate under justified effect and uncertainty requirements.

Do not invent a held-out split to supply a missing paper benchmark. Any new image-, trial- or mouse-held-out prediction evaluation is an extension; original fit-sample results must be described with their limited scope.
Do not count a lower unvalidated preprocessing loss, more favorable map, larger biological learning effect or stronger significance as surpassing the paper.
If further source recovery confirms that no ordered performance evaluation exists, reclassify this route as ineligible rather than manufacture a benchmark.
The bound improvement contract must be improvement_ready and its complete same-task comparison and admission requirements must pass.
Reproduction is calibration only; reconstructing a numerical result, changing the task or split, or achieving stronger significance alone is not success.

episode.improvement_loop: Inactive pending source recovery and confirmation of an evaluated original endpoint. If admitted later, iterate within the original source fit conditions and fixed capacity with explicitly budgeted feedback; do not silently create a generalization task.
episode.candidate_freeze: Before any admitted comparison, freeze model capacity, source-compatible fit algorithm, preprocessing, initialization/selection policy and complete evaluation manifest. The original fitting/evaluation boundaries must first be recovered.
episode.final_evaluation: No active final evaluator exists for this route. A future owner evaluation must compare candidate and author method on the same original scored data and metric, clearly identifying any fit-sample limitation. New holdouts are extensions.
episode.baseline_policy: Published evaluated score, reproduced author fit and current SOTA are separate. Existing biological-contrast evaluators calibrate reconstruction only; neither a locally defined loss nor a new held-out benchmark substitutes for an original source score.
